newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas down in Sep but only 3 afternoon deals.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas down in Sep but only 3 afternoon deals.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw another thin afternoon on Thursday, with only three trades done, all in the last five minutes before the 1600 GMT close of the contract.

All the afternoon trades were done in September, which had already traded in the morning. And the price went down throughout the day, trading last at 10.00 pence a therm, after opening at 10.20 and trading at 10.125 and 10.05 on the way down.

A futures broker attributed the disappointing performance of the futures market to the fact the OTC market was quiet. He added that the physical price was currently the main driver for futures, so there was no surprise in seeing a thin day on futures.
As well as September losing 0.15 pence a therm, the other two traded contracts, January and February, were also off by 0.015 pence and 0.05 pence, respectively.
